sources.title: Soofi: Sovereign AI from Europe - iis.fraunhofer.de
sources.snippet: Soofi S is the first foundation model in the Soofi model family and is designed for the traceable and efficient use of AI in industrial application scenarios. The open-source model forms the foundation for future, larger Soofi models - including specialized variants for multimodal and industrial applications.
